name: Ruta del agua en Jezero
notes: Waypoints educativos para visualizar ambientes antiguos relacionados con agua. Coordinates are approximate demo values.

waypoints.name: Cráter Jezero
waypoints.evidence: Ancient crater lake basin with a delta deposit.

waypoints.name: Frente del delta occidental
waypoints.evidence: Layered delta front deposited by flowing water.

waypoints.name: Neretva Vallis
waypoints.evidence: Inlet valley that fed the Jezero basin.

waypoints.name: Abanico del delta
waypoints.evidence: Fan-shaped sedimentary terrain useful for reading past water flow.
